rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE MARITIME ZONES OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to have a general declaration and definition of the maritime zones under the jurisdiction of the Philippines and to preserve and protect the country's maritime rights.

Intends to practically averts any unnecessary dispute with vessels of foreign states entering
the Philippine maritime territory without permission.

Declares that the maritime zones of the Philippines shall be comprised of its internal waters,archipelagic waters, territorial sea, continuous zone, EEZ and continental shelf; and that all territories of the Philippines shall generate their respective maritime zones in accordance with international laws.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09981

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH THE ARCHIPELAGIC SEA LANES IN THE PHILIPPINE ARCHIPELAGIC WATERS, PRESCRIBING THE RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF FOREIGN SHIPS AND AIRCRAFT EXERCISING THE RIGHT OF ARCHIPELAGIC SEA LANES PASSAGE THROUGH THE ESTABLISHED ARCHIPELAGIC SEA LANES AND PROVIDING FOR THE ASSOCIATED PROTECTED MEASURES THEREIN
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the failure of R.A.No.9522 to provide and establish the archipelagic sea lanes of the Philippines as espoused in Art.53 of the UNCLOS.

Defines \"Archipelagic sea lane\" as the designated sea lanes and air routes in the archipelagic waters through which foreign vessels or aircraft may exercise the right of archipelagic sea lanes passage.

Declares that foreign ships and aircraft exercising the right of archipelagic sea lanes passage shall pass through or above the archipelagic sea lane as quickly as possible without delay and in the normal mode solely for the purpose of continuous, expeditious and unobstructed transit; and shall not deviate 
more than 25 nautical miles to either side of the axis line of the sea lane: Provided, that such ships and aircraft shall not navigate closer to the coast more that 10% of the distance between the nearest points on the islands bordering the sea lane
rows.status: Substituted by HB10814

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING REFORMS IN REAL PROPERTY VALUATION IN THE PHILIPPINES, ESTABLISHING THE NATIONAL VALUATION AUTHORITY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to adopt a market value prevailing in the locality where the property is located, as a single real property valuation base for the assessment of real property related taxes; and to establish market value for valuing or appraising real property for various government purposes.

Proposes to separate the function of appraising and assessment of property from tax policy and tax administration, thereby creating a National Valuation Authority (NVA) to regulate and have oversight on the valuation and appraisal of real property in the country.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE ARCHIPELAGIC SEA LANES IN THE PHILIPPINE ARCHIPELAGIC WATERS, PRESCRIBING THE RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF FOREIGN SHIPS AND AIRCRAFT EXERCISING THE RIGHT OF ARCHIPELAGIC SEA LANES PASSAGE
rows.abstract:
Provides that \"Archipelagic sea lanes passage\" means the exercise, in accordance with the
United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), of the rights of navigation and
overflight of foreign ships solely for the purpose of continuous, expeditious and unobstructed transit in the normal mode of operation.

Intends to establish our archipelagic sea lanes in order that the country may fully benefit
from the provision of the UNCLOS, specifically Article 53 which states that an archipelagic
State may designate sea lanes and air routes suitable for the continuous passage of foreign
ships and aircraft through or over its archipelagic waters and the adjacent territorial sea.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10814

Identifies instances wherein an employer in the private sector shall publish notices of termination of employment in newspapers, social media and other public information venues.

rows.title_full: AN ACT LIMITING THE LIABILITY OF A CARDHOLDER FOR UNAUTHORIZED TRANSACTIONS IN CASES OF LOSS, FRAUD OR THEFT OF CREDIT OR DEBIT CARDS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10870
rows.abstract:
Intends to address the absoluteness in holding innocent cardholders solely liable for fraudulent and unauthorized transactions made before reporting the lost or stolen credit card, which runs contrary to the declared policy of that State to protect them against unfair practices, fraud, and scams.

Provides that there shall be, in the service level agreement between the acquiring banks and their partner merchants, a provision:  THE IDENTITY OF A CARDHOLDER SHALL BE ASCERTAINED BY REQUIRING THE PRESENTATION OF A VALID IDENTIFICATION CARD . . . OR SOME OTHER MEANS OF AUTHENTICATING THE IDENTITY OF THE CARDHOLDER.

Proposes that a credit card issuer shall disclose:  A CLEAR AND PROPER DESCRIPTION OF THE MEANS WHICH THE CARD ISSUER MAY BE NOTIFIED OF THE LOSS AND THEFT . . . THE TELEPHONE NUMBER DEDICATED SOLELY FOR REPORTING . . .;  A REMINDER TO THE CARDHOLDER . . . THAT THE FAILURE TO REPORT THE LOSS OR THEFT . . . WITHIN REASONABLE TIME WOULD RESULT IN POTENTIAL LIABILITY FOR UNAUTHORIZED TRANSACTIONS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 2019-07-23
